mapper.select: SELECT id, name, data_source_id, sql_query, json_path, fields, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, deleted FROM datasets WHERE NOT deleted ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, name FROM datasets WHERE data_source_id = #{dataSourceId} AND NOT deleted ORDER BY name, id
